R-01 withholding on foreign persons does not apply. Paid gross."}],"notes":"WF3 for D-002 (Atlas Growth Fund I, CP-001). Record date 2026-12-15, payment date 2027-01-12, USD 8,000,000. I prepared this through step 9 only. It has not been reviewed or signed off (steps 10 and 11), and treasury must not release payment against it.

RECONCILIATION (C3.4)
- Gross: 8,000,000. Tax withheld: 1,125,900. Net: 6,874,100.
- The gross ties to DOC-0202 and to the 12 distribution lines.
- The frozen list at the record date is AGF1 commitments, which total 100%. Each line equals 8M x unit_pct.
- Look-through splits:
  - I-002 line 1,920,000 = I-010 50% / I-011 30% / I-012 20% (ALF1 commitments).
  - I-007 line 480,000 = I-013 62.5% / I-014 37.5% (DO-001/DO-002, DOC-0107).

COMPONENT (steps 2 and 3)
- D-002-A is a US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc. (a US corporation), paid through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (disregarded, 80% of Orion) to the fund (partnership). It is subject to withholding on foreign persons.
- Rule versions are taken as at the payment date:
  - R-01 2026.1: 30%.
  - R-02 2027.1: 10% (in force 2027-01-12). It replaces R-02 2026.1 at 15% and rests on an "illustrative" 2026 Protocol (AU-03). The reviewer should confirm this protocol is actually in force.
  - R-03 2026.1: 5%, minimum vote 10%.

ITEMS FOR THE REVIEWER
1. I-003 at 5% (R-03). The 10% vote test is met exactly at the threshold: 12.5% x 80% = 10.0%.
   - It relies on looking through the fund partnership and the disregarded SPV.
   - It also relies on the voting rights of the new class A2 under side letter DOC-0003 (2026-11-24). That side letter is not digitised and I could not verify it.
   - F-003 has no stored document image.
   - If you do not accept 5%, apply R-02 at 10%: tax becomes 100,000 (+50,000).
2. I-010 is put at 10% on a conservative basis.
   - The investor register (C-002) gives the feeder 24% of the vote. Entity_mgmt H-005b gives 25% from 2026-12-01.
   - At 25%, I-010's effective vote in Orion = 25% x 50% x 80% = 10%. That would qualify for R-03 at 5% (tax 48,000 instead of 96,000).
   - The two records need to be reconciled.
3. I-011 (Moselle Capital) moved its seat to Belgium on 2026-12-01.
   - The source, DOC-0111, is not digitised. The residence record was entered on 2026-12-20.
   - Its LU treaty claim (F-011) is no longer valid, so it is defaulted at 30%. Pass to WF2 with a 2027-01-12 deadline.
   - CL-002 (feeder) does not yet reflect this change and should be reopened.
4. I-006 (Meridian Holdings I) is defaulted.
   - Its clearance relies on DO-003, which has ended. Change case K-006 is still open.
   - The ownership-based LOB claim now traces to a Jersey trust, through a circular cross-holding with Meridian Holdings II (I-018).
   - CL-006 should be revisited: the original 100%-Jersey-trust ownership also looks unable to support an ownership-based LOB.
5. I-013 (Echternach Pension Fund, behind Sterling Nominees) is defaulted.
   - Its form is recorded as valid only to 2026-12-31, before the payment date (C3.2 / S3.5).
   - The tax_form record (signed 2023-03-06) conflicts with DOC-0107 and TS-013, which point to a W-8BEN-E dated 2025-03-04.
   - If the record is corrected or renewed through WF2 before 2027-01-12, the rate becomes 10% under R-02 2027.1 (tax 30,000 instead of 90,000).
6. Defaults that cannot be cured from the data:
   - I-014 (undocumented client account behind the nominee, MF-001).
   - I-015 (clearance withdrawn, MF-002).
7. Holding instead of defaulting.
   - I did not hold any line. The fund's terms (LPA DOC-0001) are not digitised, so I could not confirm that holds are allowed.
   - Every non-cleared line uses the recorded 30% default instead.
8. Investor relations must notify these investors before payment, with the item needed to cure (C3.7):
   - I-011 (via the feeder I-002): new form reflecting its residence.
   - I-006: completed K-006 / LOB ownership chain.
   - I-013 and I-014 (via Sterling Nominees I-007): renewed or confirmed W-8BEN-E; certification for client account 7731.
   - I-015: new W-8BEN-E.
9. Harbor Pension Trust (I-001) and Echternach (I-013) are LU pension funds.
   - The rulebook has no pension-fund exemption rule, so only the general treaty rate is applied.
   - Tax may wish to check whether such a rule is missing.
10. Other data issues:
    - H-006 shows the Co-Invest Vehicle (I-016) at 3.5% economic interest, but commitment C-016 shows 3%. The line uses 3%. The difference does not affect tax (W-9, paid gross).
    - Process records are missing: there is no distribution case for D-002 in clearance.case, no CQ4 obligation_assessment rows, and no withholding_schedule or determination rows. I have read-only access, so I could not open the case or record the schedule. These need to be created.
    - Several source records (the D-002 notice of 2026-12-07, DOC-0111, the I-011 residence record) are dated after today (2026-10-15). Please confirm the data as of the date these records reflect."}
